definitions.explanation: A written or electronic reply to a message, email, or letter. The act of sending such a reply.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{返信|へんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{返信|へんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧すみません。

⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧たって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{返信|へんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|こ}なくて→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a message but haven't received a reply even after a week, so I'm worried.

notes:
Compound of {返|へん} (return) + {信|しん} (message, letter). Used as a suru-verb: {返信|へんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reply).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返信|へんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reply)
- {返信|へんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (a reply arrives)
- {返信|へんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (a reply is late)
- {返信|へんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive a reply)
- ご{返信|へんしん} (polite: your reply)

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{変身|へんしん}→変身：12099_henshin⟧ (transformation). {返信|へんしん} specifically refers to replying to correspondence. For replying in general conversation, ⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧ is more common. ⟦{返答|へんとう}→返答：10440_hentou⟧ is more formal and used for answering questions directly.
